integrity: Exact algebraic proof for the geometric Cartier strata; complete, reproducible finite-field enumeration for rational class counts; no claims of independent verification or external certification.
limitations: Only the specified cyclic degree-five family in characteristic 19 is classified. The rational-isomorphism count concerns parameters in F_19; it does not claim four geometric isomorphism classes. The existence of supersingular members and permissible Newton polygons was previously known. Bibliographic priority remains susceptible to unindexed equivalent arithmetic computations.
title: Four arithmetic classes in the characteristic-\(19\) cyclic-quintic genus-four family
